verdict.rationale: ClickUp's integrations directory documents native Slack integration (create tasks from messages, link unfurls, channel updates) and native GitHub integration (syncing commits, branches, PRs, and issues). It also claims 1,000+ tool connections, and Brain² taps Google Drive. Missing for 10: a documented native Google Drive integration beyond the Brain² AI connector mention, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the integrations.
